spm_software.linux_install_prompt_2:
RPM parameter:-- Nodeps ignores dependencies and forces installation. Even if the dependency package is missing, installation will continue-- Force installation, even if it will overwrite already installed files or packages-- Replacepkgs Reinstall installed packages and replace existing files-- Even if replacefiles overwrite files from other packages, continue to install-- Test only tests the installation process and does not actually install the package-- Prefix=<path>specifies the installation path (only applicable to packages that support relocation)-- Relocate=<oldpath>=<newpath>Repositions the installation path of the package from<oldpath>to<newpath>-- Excludedoc does not install document files-- IgnoreSize ignores disk space check-- Noscripts do not execute pre installation and post installation scripts in the package-- Nopost does not execute the post installation script in the package-- Nopre does not execute pre installed scripts in the package-- Nodigest ignores the summary validation of the package-- Nosignature ignores package signature verification.

Deb parameter:-- Force pending ignores dependencies and forces installation-- Install and use the new version of the configuration file for force con new-- Install and keep the old version of the configuration file for force info.
